name: a(n) = 3^(n+1) + (3^n-1)/2.
line: First differences of A108765. The digital root of a(n) for n > 1 is always 4. a(n) is never divisible by 7 or by 12. a(n) == 10 (mod 84) for odd n. a(n) == 31 (mod 84) for even n > 0. Conjecture: This sequence contains no prime factors p == {11, 13, 23, 61 71, 73} (mod 84). - _Klaus Purath_, Apr 13 2020
premise_kind: stated by the entry as fact
